title: AFK Blaze Loot
description: Get Blaze Rods without player kills. AFK.
body:
Do you grow tired of standing around to get a few blaze rods? 

Would you like to do something more important? Such as eat dinner, take a shower, sleep or go fencing with your mates? Then this datapack is for you.

This is a small quality of life change, make blaze grinders a little more useful for the chronically AFK player.

Enjoy. I wanted this, and no one else had a current version, hopefully I filled a niche. I will be updating it periodically.
